𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗟𝗔𝗞𝗘 𝗖𝗔𝗟𝗟𝗘𝗗 𝗨𝗣! 🇦🇺

Bartlett (knee) joins Beardman (quad) out of Australia's T20I series vs England.

Billy Stanlake is the replacement. 1st T20I: MCG, tomorrow.

Who wins the series? 👇

👉 Xavier Bartlett knee injury ki wajah se England T20I series se bahar
👉 Mahli Beardman (quad strain) pehle hi out hain
👉 Billy Stanlake ko replacement ke taur par bulaya gaya
